trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order and this one takes care of itself. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, so expect a long, relaxed hunt rather than a hard one.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, ends with this trophy. Just play the story — it is automatic and cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy — nothing special to do. One warning: meditate at the spot at home before the chapter ends, because that first meditation for Positive Mental Attitude does not come back.
steps: Before the chapter ends: meditate at home (see Positive Mental Attitude)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Automatic story trophy. Chapter 2 is where both Jason and Lucia become playable, which opens most of the side list — stranger strands, partner trophies and activities all start to unlock from here.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Automatic story trophy — keep playing the story and it comes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) only appears after the story, but progress you made earlier counts. PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion — the thresholds are lenient — and most of it comes from doing the other trophies. The checklist asks for things like 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, scanning 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles and studying 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars. It is the hardest trophy on the list, but it is a long checklist, not a hard one.
steps: Work the checklist: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida count. PowerPyx breaks them down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road. Stunt jumps in cars and bikes are the easiest to grind.
steps: Do any 250 stunts: jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights, base jumps
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The tracker counts 9 activity types — play one of each and it pops. Use the in-game activity list to see which types you have not tried yet.
steps: Try one of each of the 9 activity types

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 12 shooting range locations and 42 challenges between them. Gold each one — take your time, learn the target pattern at each range, and use the range's own weapon so the recoil feels the same every run.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations. Win one race at each — fly a practice run to learn the gates first, then go for the win.
steps: Race at all 14 Top Fun locations
Win at least one race at each

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, off-road, boat and air races all feed it. Vary the vehicle class if one series feels slow.
steps: Win 20 different races across any race types

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots in 10 locations, and both Jason and Lucia can meditate. This is the one trophy the published guides flag as potentially missable: the first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and is gone for good once that chapter ends, so meditate at home before you finish Chapter 1. After that, work through the remaining spots as you explore — and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter in case you miss one.
steps: Chapter 1: meditate at the spot at home before finishing the chapter
Meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida (18 total, 10 locations)

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret points you at one specific animal — track it, take it down, and bring the hunt home. Do it while Bret's strand is open.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Finish any 3 sets — use a card map to avoid wandering and tick sets off as you travel.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game tracks 80 challenges in all; any 50 will do. The 100% checklist wants 70, so the extra 20 are already on your route to A Long Road. Mix easy challenges in with the long ones.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Do it while your partner is available — partners come and go with the story, so do not leave it for after the credits.
steps: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level
Escape and stay out of sight until it clears
